title: Verify that a merchant can view a list of all incoming transactions on the Transactions page
Verify that a newly completed payment appears in the merchant's transaction list after refreshing or reopening the Transactions page
Verify that a merchant can open a completed transaction and view its customer payment details
Verify that a merchant can open a pending transaction and see its status without error or failure details
Verify that a merchant can view transactions originating from different payment channels in the same list
note: 37333 confirms payment channel in the detail view; showing multiple channels together in the list itself isn't explicitly stated

title: Verify that a failed transaction's detail view shows the error or reason for failure
Verify that a merchant cannot view another merchant's transactions
note: cross-merchant access control isn't stated in any of the three in-scope stories — standard security expectation, not sourced AC

title: Verify that an unauthenticated user cannot access the Transactions page
note: unauthenticated-access blocking isn't stated in any of the three in-scope stories — inferred, not sourced AC

title: Verify that the Transactions page displays a clear empty state when the merchant has no transactions yet
note: empty-state behavior isn't addressed in any of the three stories

title: Verify that a transaction's status updates from Pending to Completed when viewed again after the underlying payment completes
Verify that filtering and export controls are not present on the Transactions page for Release 1
note: tests the absence of these two explicitly-out-of-scope stories' functionality, not their AC — flagging since 'Tested By' usually links to AC a case validates, not scope it confirms absent
